newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan civil servants end strike.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan civil servants end strike.

text.p: Thousands of Venezuelan civil servants ended a 15-day strike on Wednesday after the government paid overdue salary bonuses, union officials said.
"Now that the reason (for the strike) does not exist workers must go back to work today," Carlos Borges, president of the public sector union FEDEUNEP, told Reuters by telephone.
The strike, originally billed as a 48-hour stoppage when it started on Nov. 19, was in protest over the late payment of wage bonuses promised in February.
Union leaders had said the government owed staff, who earn average wages equivalent to $106 per month, a total of 71 billion bolivars ($150 million).
Despite the length of the strike, government officials played down its impact, saying that few of the 1.3 million public sector employees had actually stayed away from work.
